'''d'Ashewl''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] for [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]. He had been inserted into the [[Imperial Court/Legends|Imperial Court]] as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]].<ref name="Scoundrels" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], he worked with [[Dayja/Legends|Dayja]] to hunt a [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Qazadi]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wukkar/Legends|Wukkar]].
